mapper.select: SELECT si.shopping_item_id , si.household_id , si.name , si.memo , si.store_type , si.status , si.favorite , si.purchased_at , si.created_at , CASE WHEN att.shopping_item_id IS NOT NULL THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END AS has_image FROM t_shopping_item si LEFT JOIN ( SELECT shopping_item_id FROM t_shopping_item_attachment GROUP BY shopping_item_id ) att ON si.shopping_item_id = att.shopping_item_id WHERE si.household_id = #{householdId} AND ( si.status IN ('0', '1') OR ( si.status = '9' AND si.purchased_at >= date_add(now(), INTERVAL - 5 DAY) ) ) ORDER BY si.shopping_item_id DESC;
